hello.note: Literally 'peace'. More respectful, e.g. to elders: ጤና ይስጥልኝ (tena yistilign).

goodbye.note: To a man: ደህና ሁን (dehna hun); to a woman: ደህና ሁኚ (dehna hugni). Casual: ቻው (chaw).

please.note: Polite form for strangers. To a man: እባክህ (ibakih); to a woman: እባክሽ (ibakish).

thank_you.note: Thanks a lot: በጣም አመሰግናለሁ (betam ameseginalehu). Also common: እግዚአብሔር ይስጥልኝ (igziabher yistilign).

youre_welcome.note: Literally 'it's nothing'. In quick speech often shortened to ምንም አይደል (minim aydel).

yes.note: To agree to a request, say እሺ (ishi), 'OK'. People also say yes with a quick intake of breath.

no.note: Fuller: አይ፣ አይደለም (ay, aydelem), 'no, it isn't'. 'There isn't any': የለም (yelem).

sorry.note: Same word as 'excuse me'. A fuller apology: ይቅርታ ያድርጉልኝ (yikirta yadirgulign).

excuse_me.note: Same word as 'sorry'. Before asking a stranger something, ጤና ይስጥልኝ (tena yistilign) is also polite.

good_morning.note: To a man: እንደምን አደርክ (indemin aderk); to a woman: እንደምን አደርሽ (indemin adersh).

how_are_you.note: To a man: እንዴት ነህ? (indet neh?); to a woman: እንዴት ነሽ? (indet nesh?)

im_fine.note: Very common: ደህና ነኝ፣ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን (dehna negn, igziabher yimesgen), 'fine, thank God'.

whats_your_name.note: Amharic asks 'who' (ማን) is your name. To a man: ስምህ (simih); to a woman: ስምሽ (simish).

where_from.note: To a man: ከየት ነህ? (keyet neh?); to a woman: ከየት ነሽ? (keyet nesh?)

im_from.note: ከ (ke-) 'from' joins the country: ከጀርመን ነኝ (keJermen negn), 'I'm from Germany'.

speak_english.note: Everyday: እንግሊዝኛ ይችላሉ? (inglizigna yichilalu?), 'can you [do] English?'

dont_understand.note: Please repeat that: እባክዎ ይድገሙት (ibakwo yidgemut).

speak_slowly.note: To a man: እባክህ ቀስ ብለህ ተናገር (ibakih kes bileh tenager).

where.note: Where is …?: … የት ነው? (… yet new?)

what.note: Didn't catch it? Say ምን አሉ? (min alu?), 'what did you say?' (polite).

how_much.note: Also: ዋጋው ስንት ነው? (wagaw sint new?), 'what's the price?'

where_bathroom.note: More everyday but blunter: ሽንት ቤት (shint bet).

can_you_help.note: To a man: ልትረዳኝ ትችላለህ? (litredagn tichilaleh?)

what_time.note: Ethiopian time counts from 6 a.m., so 7 a.m. is 'one o'clock' (አንድ ሰዓት). Check which clock is meant.

three.note: Ethiopic numeral: ፫. Also spelled ሶስት.

ten.note: Ethiopic numeral: ፲. Also spelled አስር.

coffee.note: Coffee with milk: ማኪያቶ (makiato), hugely popular.

bread.note: The staple flatbread is እንጀራ (injera); ዳቦ is ordinary bread.

delicious.note: Also: ጣፋጭ ነው! (tafach new!). ጣፋጭ can also mean 'sweet'.

no_meat.note: Ask for የጾም ምግብ (yetsom migib), 'fasting food': vegan dishes, easy to find.

enjoy_meal.note: At the table people also invite each other with እንብላ! (inbila!), 'let's eat!'

left.note: To the left: ወደ ግራ (wede gira).

right.note: To the right: ወደ ቀኝ (wede kegn).

straight_ahead.note: Go straight on: ቀጥ ብለው ይሂዱ (ket bilew yihidu).

stop_here.note: In a shared minibus, call out ወራጅ አለ! (weraj ale!), 'someone's getting off!'

airport.note: Everyday: ኤርፖርት (erport). In Addis Ababa people often just say ቦሌ (Bole).

hotel.note: In Ethiopia ሆቴል is also used for a restaurant.

is_it_far.note: Is it close?: ቅርብ ነው? (kirb new?)

cheaper.note: To haggle: ትንሽ ይቀንሱልኝ (tinish yikensulign), 'bring the price down a little'.

id_like_this.note: I'll take this: ይሄንን እወስዳለሁ (yihenin iwesdalehu).

small.note: Also means 'a little': ትንሽ ውሃ (tinish wiha), 'a little water'.

good_evening.note: To a man: እንደምን አመሸህ (indemin amesheh); to a woman: እንደምን አመሸሽ (indemin ameshesh).

good_night.note: To a man: ደህና እደር (dehna ider); to a woman: ደህና እደሪ (dehna ideri).

wait_moment.note: Casual, to a man: አንዴ ቆይ (ande koy); to a woman: አንዴ ቆዪ (ande koyi).

call_police.note: To one man: ፖሊስ ጥራ! (polis tira!). Here ጥሩ means 'call', not 'good'.

im_lost.note: Literally 'the road got lost on me'.

allergic.note: ለ (le-) joins the allergen: ለወተት አለርጂ አለብኝ (lewetet alerji alebign), 'allergic to milk'.

be_careful.note: To a man: ተጠንቀቅ! (tetenkek!); to a woman: ተጠንቀቂ! (tetenkeki!)

i_like_it.note: Also: ደስ ይለኛል (des yilegnal), 'it pleases me'.

im_happy.note: Describing yourself as a happy person: ደስተኛ ነኝ (destegna negn).

welcome.note: To a man: እንኳን ደህና መጣህ! (inkwan dehna metah!); to a woman: እንኳን ደህና መጣሽ! (inkwan dehna metash!)

congratulations.note: To a man: እንኳን ደስ አለህ! (inkwan des aleh!); to a woman: እንኳን ደስ አለሽ! (inkwan des alesh!)

child.note: Son: ወንድ ልጅ (wend lij); daughter: ሴት ልጅ (set lij). Children: ልጆች (lijoch).

friend.note: Same word for a woman. My friend: ጓደኛዬ (gwadegnaye).

this_is_my_friend.note: Introducing a woman: ይቺ ጓደኛዬ ናት (yichi gwadegnaye nat).

are_you_married.note: To a man: ባለትዳር ነህ? (baletidar neh?); to a woman: ባለትዳር ነሽ? (baletidar nesh?)

have_children.note: To a man: ልጆች አሉህ? (lijoch aluh?); to a woman: ልጆች አሉሽ? (lijoch alush?)

weekend.note: Literally 'Saturday and Sunday'. More formal: የሳምንቱ መጨረሻ (yesamintu mecheresha).

what_day.note: The date: ዛሬ ቀኑ ስንት ነው? (zare kenu sint new?). Ethiopia has its own calendar.

next_week.note: As in 'I'll come next week': በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት (bemiketilew samint).

eleven.note: Ethiopic numeral: ፲፩. 11–19 are አሥራ (asra) + one to nine. Also spelled አስራ.

thirty.note: Ethiopic numeral: ፴. Also spelled ሰላሳ.

hundred.note: Ethiopic numeral: ፻. More formally: አንድ መቶ (and meto).

thousand.note: Ethiopic numeral: ፲፻. Often written ሺ, and ሺህ alone also means 'a thousand'.

how_old.note: To a man: ዕድሜህ ስንት ነው? (idmeh sint new?); to a woman: ዕድሜሽ ስንት ነው? (idmesh sint new?)

years_old.note: E.g. ሃያ ዓመቴ ነው (haya amete new), 'I'm 20'. Also: ዕድሜዬ … ነው (idmeye … new).

what_colour.note: Also: ምን ዓይነት ቀለም ነው? (min aynet kelem new?)

this_one.note: I want this one: ይሄኛውን እፈልጋለሁ (yihegnawin ifelgalehu).

that_one.note: Give me that one: ያኛውን ይስጡኝ (yagnawin yistugn).

another_one.note: Also common: ሌላ አንድ (lela and), e.g. ሌላ አንድ ቡና (lela and buna), 'another coffee'.

its_raining.note: It's about to rain: ሊዘንብ ነው (lizenib new).

its_sunny.note: Like ዝናብ ነው (zinab new) for rain. More formal: ፀሐያማ ነው (tsehayama new).

its_windy.note: Very windy: ብዙ ነፋስ አለ (bizu nefas ale).

beautiful_day.note: Also: አየሩ ደስ ይላል (ayeru des yilal), 'the weather is lovely'.

summer.note: Ethiopia's dry, sunny season, which comes in the northern winter months.

winter.note: Ethiopia's rainy season, roughly June to September: cool and wet, not snowy.

have_reservation.note: Literally 'I've booked a room'. Hotels also say ሪዘርቬሽን አለኝ (rizerveshin alegn).

room.note: Any rooms free?: ክፍት ክፍል አለ? (kift kifil ale?)

luggage.note: Also means a suitcase or bag. My luggage: ሻንጣዬ (shantaye).

wifi_password.note: Very common: ፓስወርዱ ስንት ነው? (paswerdu sint new?), asking 'how many' since codes are often numbers.

check_out_time.note: Literally 'what time must I leave the room?'. Hotels also say ቼክ አውት (chek awt).

next_train.note: When does it leave?: መቼ ይነሳል? (meche yinesal?)

is_this_seat_free.note: Literally 'does this place have someone?', so 'no' (የለውም, yelewim) means it's free.

what_do_you_do.note: To a man: ምን ሥራ ትሠራለህ? (min sira tiseraleh?); to a woman: ምን ሥራ ትሠሪያለሽ? (min sira tiseriyalesh?)

i_work_in.note: E.g. ባንክ ውስጥ እሠራለሁ (bank wist iseralehu). For a field: በሽያጭ ዘርፍ (beshiyach zerf), 'in sales'.

meeting.note: I'm in a meeting: ስብሰባ ላይ ነኝ (sibseba lay negn).

im_busy.note: Busy right now: ሥራ ላይ ነኝ (sira lay negn), 'I'm at work'. Casual in cities: ቢዚ ነኝ (bizi negn).

day_off.note: I'm off today: ዛሬ እረፍት ነኝ (zare ireft negn).

colleague.note: Same for a woman. Everyday: የሥራ ጓደኛ (yesira gwadegna), 'work friend'.

good_job.note: Said to a man or a woman. Also: በርታ! (berta!), 'keep it up!'; to a woman: በርቺ! (berchi!)

table_for_two.note: Asking if there's room: ለሁለት ሰው ቦታ አለ? (lehulet sew bota ale?)

not_spicy.note: Spicy food 'burns' (ያቃጥላል, yakatilal). Mild stews are called አልጫ (alicha).

vegetarian_food.note: Literally 'fasting food': vegan dishes, served everywhere, especially on Wednesdays and Fridays.

no_sugar.note: Coffee and tea often come sweet, so say it when ordering. A little sugar: ትንሽ ስኳር (tinish sikwar).

im_full.note: Also: ጠገብኩ (tegebku). When a host keeps offering: በቃኝ (bekagn), 'that's enough for me'.

takeaway.note: Literally 'please pack it for me'. Cafés also say ቴክ አዌይ (tek awey).

it_was_delicious.note: Also: በጣም ጣፍጦኛል (betam taftognal), 'I really enjoyed it'.

keep_change.note: To a man: መልሱን ያዘው (melsun yazew); to a woman: መልሱን ያዢው (melsun yazhiw).

stomach.note: My stomach hurts: ሆዴን አመመኝ (hoden amemegn).

head_hurts.note: Also: ራስ ምታት አለብኝ (ras mitat alebign), 'I have a headache'.

call_ambulance.note: To one man: አምቡላንስ ጥራ! (ambulans tira!). Here ጥሩ means 'call', not 'good'.

need_rest.note: Also: እረፍት ያስፈልገኛል (ireft yasfelgegnal), 'I need rest'.

feel_better.note: Often with thanks: ተሽሎኛል፣ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን (teshilognal, igziabher yimesgen).

get_well.note: To a man: ቶሎ ይሻልህ! (tolo yishalih!). Very common too: እግዚአብሔር ይማርዎ! (igziabher yimarwo!)

lets_meet.note: E.g. ነገ እንገናኝ (nege ingenagn), 'let's meet tomorrow'.

are_you_free.note: To a man: ነገ ጊዜ አለህ? (nege gize aleh?); to a woman: ነገ ጊዜ አለሽ? (nege gize alesh?)

call_me.note: To a man: ደውልልኝ (dewlilign); to a woman: ደውይልኝ (dewyilign).

your_number.note: To a man: ስልክህ ስንት ነው? (silkih sint new?); to a woman: ስልክሽ ስንት ነው? (silkish sint new?)

have_nice_day.note: መልካም works for many wishes: መልካም ጉዞ! (melkam guzo!), 'have a good trip!'

thanks_a_lot.note: Warm, to a man: ተባረክ! (tebarek!), 'be blessed'; to a woman: ተባረኪ! (tebareki!)

miss_you.note: To a woman: ናፍቀሽኛል (nafkeshignal). To several people: ናፍቃችሁኛል (nafkachihugnal).
